Usage: rdt search [OPTIONS] QUERY

  Search Reddit posts

  Examples:   rdt search "python async"   rdt search "rust vs go" -r
  programming --sort top --time year

Options:
  -r, --subreddit TEXT            Search within subreddit
  -s, --sort [relevance|hot|top|new|comments]
                                  Sort order
  -t, --time [hour|day|week|month|year|all]
                                  Time filter
  -n, --limit INTEGER             Number of results
  --after TEXT                    Pagination cursor
  --json                          Output as JSON
  --yaml                          Output as YAML
  -o, --output TEXT               Save structured output to file (JSON/YAML)
  --full-text                     Show full title/text without truncation
  -c, --compact                   Compact output (fewer fields, agent-
                                  friendly)
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
